Hello, Fauji sahab? Shakeel bol raha hoo.text: Shakeel says the caller is the mason and mentions the Rewari plot whose measurement was arranged.
Hello, Fauji sahab? Shakeel bol raha hoo.quote: Hello, Fauji sahab? Shakeel bol raha hoon, mistri. Aapne plot ka naap dilwaya tha, Rewari wala.

Haan Shakeel. Bolo. Hisaab bana?.text: Devendra says he is listening and asks whether the حساب has been made.

Ji bana liya. Ek sau assi foot lambi dee.text: Shakeel says the wall is 180 feet long, 6 feet high, with 9-inch bricks and two pillars for the gate.
Ji bana liya. Ek sau assi foot lambi dee.quote: Ji bana liya. Ek sau assi foot lambi deewar, chhe foot oonchi, nau inch ki eent, aur do pillar gate ke.

Bahar ki taraf plaster, andar ki taraf n.text: Shakeel says the plaster is only on the outside, not inside, as the hirer said.
Bahar ki taraf plaster, andar ki taraf n.quote: Bahar ki taraf plaster, andar ki taraf nahi, jaise aapne bola tha.

Bahar ki taraf plaster, andar ki taraf n.text: Shakeel says the inside is a field and does not need plaster.
Bahar ki taraf plaster, andar ki taraf n.value: inside is a field; no need for plaster
Bahar ki taraf plaster, andar ki taraf n.quote: Andar to khet hai, zaroorat nahi.

Fauji sahab, sab milake, eent, cement, r.text: Shakeel says the total for everything together, including bricks, cement, sand, steel, and labor, comes to 210,000 rupees.
Fauji sahab, sab milake, eent, cement, r.quote: Fauji sahab, sab milake, eent, cement, ret, sariya, mazdoori, do lakh das hazaar banta hai.

Fauji sahab, sab milake, eent, cement, r.text: Shakeel says the job is on contract basis.
Fauji sahab, sab milake, eent, cement, r.quote: Fauji sahab, sab milake, eent, cement, ret, sariya, mazdoori, do lakh das hazaar banta hai. Theke pe.

Do lakh das? Shakeel, maine teen jagah s.text: The hirer says that the price is two lakh ten thousand rupees.
The hirer says he asked three places.
Do lakh das? Shakeel, maine teen jagah s.quote: Shakeel, maine teen jagah se poocha hai.

Do lakh das? Shakeel, maine teen jagah s.text: The hirer says others are doing it for one and a half lakh rupees.
Do lakh das? Shakeel, maine teen jagah s.quote: Dedh lakh mein log kar rahe hain.

Dedh mein to peeli kachchi eent lagayeng.text: The worker says that for 150,000 rupees they would use inferior yellow bricks.
Dedh mein to peeli kachchi eent lagayeng.quote: Dedh mein to peeli kachchi eent lagayenge, sahab.

Dedh mein to peeli kachchi eent lagayeng.text: The worker says he uses good red bricks, number one, for the wall.
Dedh mein to peeli kachchi eent lagayeng.quote: Main pakki laal eent lagata hoon, number one.

Dedh mein to peeli kachchi eent lagayeng.text: The worker says the wall will last twenty years.
Dedh mein to peeli kachchi eent lagayeng.quote: Aapki deewar bees saal khadi rahegi.

Paune do lakh. Isse upar nahi..text: The hirer offers 175,000 rupees for the job.

Paune do... sahab, aap fauji aadmi ho, a.text: Shakeel says the job is agreed at 175,000 rupees including materials.
Paune do... sahab, aap fauji aadmi ho, a.quote: Paune do... sahab, aap fauji aadmi ho, aapse kya behes karni. Chalo, paune do lakh, material samet.

Paune do... sahab, aap fauji aadmi ho, a.text: Shakeel says the price is 190,000 rupees including materials.
Paune do... sahab, aap fauji aadmi ho, a.quote: Paune do... sahab, aap fauji aadmi ho, aapse kya behes karni. Chalo, paune do lakh, material samet.

Paune do. Theek. Paisa kaise?.text: The hirer accepts the 175,000 rupees price by saying 'Paune do. Theek.'
The hirer asks how the rest of the money will be paid.

Pachaas hazaar shuru mein, material gira.text: Shakeel says 50,000 rupees is to be paid at the start, with the material to be brought down.
Pachaas hazaar shuru mein, material gira.quote: Pachaas hazaar shuru mein, material girana hai.

Pachaas hazaar shuru mein, material gira.text: Shakeel says 75,000 rupees will be paid when the wall reaches shoulder height.
Pachaas hazaar shuru mein, material gira.value: 75,000 rupees when the wall reaches shoulder height
Pachaas hazaar shuru mein, material gira.quote: Phir jab deewar kandhe tak aa jaye to pachhattar hazaar,

Pachaas hazaar shuru mein, material gira.text: Shakeel says the remaining 50,000 rupees will be paid after the plaster is done.
Pachaas hazaar shuru mein, material gira.quote: aur baaki pachaas plaster ke baad.

Pachaas, pachhattar, pachaas. Haan, paun.text: The hirer says 175,000 rupees is accepted as the total price.
Pachaas, pachhattar, pachaas. Haan, paun.quote: Pachaas, pachhattar, pachaas. Haan, paune do hue. Chalega.

Pachaas, pachhattar, pachaas. Haan, paun.text: The hirer says the advance of 50,000 rupees is accepted.
Pachaas, pachhattar, pachaas. Haan, paun.quote: Pachaas, pachhattar, pachaas. Haan, paune do hue. Chalega.

Pachaas, pachhattar, pachaas. Haan, paun.text: The hirer says the balance is 75,000 rupees when the wall reaches shoulder height and 50,000 rupees after plaster.
Pachaas, pachhattar, pachaas. Haan, paun.value: 75,000 rupees when the wall reaches shoulder height; 50,000 rupees after plaster
Pachaas, pachhattar, pachaas. Haan, paun.quote: Pachaas, pachhattar, pachaas. Haan, paune do hue. Chalega.

Kaam kab shuru?.text: Devendra Yadav asks when the work will start.

Das December se lag jaate hain. Abhi Dha.text: Shakeel says the work will start on 10 December and the other job in Dharuhera will be finished by the 9th.
Das December se lag jaate hain. Abhi Dha.quote: Das December se lag jaate hain. Abhi Dharuhera mein ek kothi ka kaam chal raha hai, woh nau tak nipat jayega.

Teen hafte. Ikattis December tak deewar.text: The worker says the wall will be up by December 31, with plaster included, and the job will take three weeks.
Teen hafte. Ikattis December tak deewar.quote: Teen hafte. Ikattis December tak deewar khadi, plaster samet.

Ikattis. Dekho Shakeel, January mein mer.text: The hirer says that after the 31st, he will deduct 1,000 rupees per day.
Ikattis. Dekho Shakeel, January mein mer.quote: Ikattis ke baad har din ka ek hazaar kaatunga.

Ek hazaar roz... sahab, baarish ho gayi.text: The worker says if it rains or if the cement truck arrives late, then the situation changes.
Ek hazaar roz... sahab, baarish ho gayi.quote: Ek hazaar roz... sahab, baarish ho gayi to? Ya cement ki gaadi late aaye to?

Baarish ke din nahi ginenge. Cement tumh.text: The hirer says rainy days will not be counted.
The hirer says cement is the worker's responsibility and is on the contract.
Baarish ke din nahi ginenge. Cement tumh.quote: Cement tumhari zimmedari hai, theke pe hai.

Theek hai sahab. Baarish chhod ke, ikatt.text: The worker agrees to 1,000 rupees per day after December 31, excluding rainy days.
Theek hai sahab. Baarish chhod ke, ikatt.quote: Theek hai sahab. Baarish chhod ke, ikattis ke baad hazaar roz. Manzoor.

Aur kaam beech mein chhoda to jitna kaam.text: The hirer says if the work is left midway, payment will be only for the work completed and the बाकी will be returned.
Aur kaam beech mein chhoda to jitna kaam.value: partial payment for work done; remaining money वापस
Aur kaam beech mein chhoda to jitna kaam.quote: Aur kaam beech mein chhoda to jitna kaam hua utna hi paisa, baaki wapas.

Arre sahab, Shakeel ne aaj tak koi kaam.text: The worker says Shakeel has not left any job unfinished so far.
Arre sahab, Shakeel ne aaj tak koi kaam.quote: Arre sahab, Shakeel ne aaj tak koi kaam adhoora nahi chhoda.

Arre sahab, Shakeel ne aaj tak koi kaam.text: The worker accepts the rule that if the work is left unfinished, only the completed work will be paid and the rest returned.
Arre sahab, Shakeel ne aaj tak koi kaam.value: partial payment for work done; remaining money returned

Theek hai. Pachaas hazaar das tareekh ko.text: The hirer accepts the 50,000 rupees advance the worker and hirer had already agreed to.
The hirer says he will give 50,000 rupees on the 10th at the site as advance.
Theek hai. Pachaas hazaar das tareekh ko.value: 50,000 rupees on the 10th at the site
Theek hai. Pachaas hazaar das tareekh ko.quote: Pachaas hazaar das tareekh ko de dunga, site pe hi.

Haan, Ladakh mein hai. Captain hai..text: The hirer says his son is in Ladakh and is a captain.
Haan, Ladakh mein hai. Captain hai..quote: Haan, Ladakh mein hai. Captain hai.

Masha Allah. Mera chhota bhi bharti ki t.text: The worker says his younger child is preparing to join the army as an Agniveer and is a bit weak at running.
Masha Allah. Mera chhota bhi bharti ki t.quote: Masha Allah. Mera chhota bhi bharti ki tayyari kar raha hai, Agniveer ki. Daud mein thoda kamzor hai.

Subah chaar baje uthao usko, paanch kilo.text: The hirer says to wake him up at 4 a.m. and make him run 5 kilometers every day for 2 months so he will improve.
Subah chaar baje uthao usko, paanch kilo.quote: Subah chaar baje uthao usko, paanch kilometre roz. Do mahine mein theek ho jayega.

Aap hi samjhao usko sahab, meri to sunta.text: The worker says the hirer should explain it to the child because the child does not listen to him.
Aap hi samjhao usko sahab, meri to sunta.quote: Aap hi samjhao usko sahab, meri to sunta nahi.

Bhej dena kisi din plot pe. Chalo Shakee.text: The hirer says to send him to the plot someday and says to meet on the 10th.
Bhej dena kisi din plot pe. Chalo Shakee.quote: Bhej dena kisi din plot pe. Chalo Shakeel, das ko milte hain.

Ji sahab, das ko subah aath baje. Khuda.text: Shakeel says to meet at 8 a.m. on the 10th.
Ji sahab, das ko subah aath baje. Khuda.quote: Ji sahab, das ko subah aath baje. Khuda hafiz.

Badhiya sahab. Neev bhar di, aaj teesra.text: Shakeel says the wall has been filled up to the foundation and is three feet high up to forty feet, on the third day.
Badhiya sahab. Neev bhar di, aaj teesra.quote: Badhiya sahab. Neev bhar di, aaj teesra din hai, chaalis foot tak teen foot oonchi ho gayi.

Zaroor aaiye. Sahab, ek baat thi. Eent w.text: The worker says the brick rate has been increased from 8.5 rupees per brick to 9 rupees per brick.
Zaroor aaiye. Sahab, ek baat thi. Eent w.quote: Zaroor aaiye. Sahab, ek baat thi. Eent wala rate badha raha hai, saadhe aath rupaye se nau rupaye eent kar di usne.

Woh tumhara mamla hai Shakeel. Theke pe.text: Devendra says that is Shakeel's matter and that the contract was already discussed.
Woh tumhara mamla hai Shakeel. Theke pe.quote: Woh tumhara mamla hai Shakeel. Theke pe baat hui thi.

Haan sahab, haan, main kuch extra nahi m.text: Shakeel says the wall will reach shoulder height by next week.
Haan sahab, haan, main kuch extra nahi m.value: reach shoulder height by next week
Haan sahab, haan, main kuch extra nahi m.quote: Haan sahab, haan, main kuch extra nahi maang raha, bas bata raha tha. Agle hafte tak deewar kandhe tak pahunch jayegi, tab sava lakh ka intezaam rakhna.

Haan sahab, haan, main kuch extra nahi m.text: Shakeel says to keep 125,000 rupees ready then.
Haan sahab, haan, main kuch extra nahi m.quote: Haan sahab, haan, main kuch extra nahi maang raha, bas bata raha tha. Agle hafte tak deewar kandhe tak pahunch jayegi, tab sava lakh ka intezaam rakhna.

Haan haan, intezaam ho jayega. Tum kaam.text: Devendra says arrangements will be made.

Ji. Aur sahab, ek suggestion hai. Gate w.text: The worker proposes making the wall on the gate side 7 feet high instead of 6 feet because the road there is higher.
Ji. Aur sahab, ek suggestion hai. Gate w.quote: Ji. Aur sahab, ek suggestion hai. Gate wali side pe sadak oonchi hai, wahan chhe foot ki deewar chhoti lagegi. Saat foot kar dein?

Saat foot... poori deewar?.text: Devendra asks whether the whole wall should be seven feet.

Nahi nahi, sirf saamne wali, sadak wali,.text: The worker says only the front road-side part should be seven feet long, and the rest should stay six feet.
Nahi nahi, sirf saamne wali, sadak wali,.value: front road-side part seven feet long; rest six feet
Nahi nahi, sirf saamne wali, sadak wali,.quote: Nahi nahi, sirf saamne wali, sadak wali, saath foot lambi hai. Baaki chhe hi rahegi.

Kitna extra?.text: Devendra asks how much extra it would be.

Eent aur mazdoori milake, bees hazaar..text: Shakeel says the extra work for bricks and labor costs 20,000 rupees.
Eent aur mazdoori milake, bees hazaar..quote: Eent aur mazdoori milake, bees hazaar.

Bees zyada hai. Saath foot pe ek foot. B.text: Devendra proposes 12,000 rupees as the extra amount for the seven-foot front road-side section.
Bees zyada hai. Saath foot pe ek foot. B.quote: Bees zyada hai. Saath foot pe ek foot. Baarah kar lo.

Sahab, ek foot oonchai matlab saath foot.text: The worker says the extra for the seven-foot front side is 15,000 rupees or more.
Sahab, ek foot oonchai matlab saath foot.quote: Sahab, ek foot oonchai matlab saath foot pe do raddhe extra, upar se pillar bhi ooncha karna padega. Pandrah se kam nahi hoga.

Pandrah. Theek hai, kar do. Pandrah plas.quote: Pandrah. Theek hai, kar do. Pandrah plaster wale ke saath dena, alag nahi.

Pandrah. Theek hai, kar do. Pandrah plas.text: The hirer says the 15,000 rupees should be paid together with the plaster payment, not separately.
Pandrah. Theek hai, kar do. Pandrah plas.value: with the plaster payment, not separately
Pandrah. Theek hai, kar do. Pandrah plas.quote: Pandrah. Theek hai, kar do. Pandrah plaster wale ke saath dena, alag nahi.

Ji sahab, plaster ke baad pachaas plus p.text: The worker accepts the hirer's 15,000 rupees extra and says the total becomes 65,000 rupees.
Ji sahab, plaster ke baad pachaas plus p.quote: Ji sahab, plaster ke baad pachaas plus pandrah, painsath. Pakka.

Ji sahab, plaster ke baad pachaas plus p.text: The worker says 50,000 rupees after plaster plus 15,000 rupees makes 65,000 rupees, and says it is definite.
Ji sahab, plaster ke baad pachaas plus p.quote: Ji sahab, plaster ke baad pachaas plus pandrah, painsath. Pakka.

Aur date? Ek foot badhne se late to nahi.text: The hirer asks about the date and whether increasing by one foot will cause a delay.
Aur date? Ek foot badhne se late to nahi.quote: Aur date? Ek foot badhne se late to nahi hoga?

Nahi sahab, ikattis hi. Do mazdoor aur l.text: The worker says the finish will be the 31st, not later.
The worker says he will add two more laborers.

Dekho, ikattis ke baad wala hisaab yaad.text: The hirer recalls that the remaining payment after the 31st is the agreed account.
Dekho, ikattis ke baad wala hisaab yaad.quote: Dekho, ikattis ke baad wala hisaab yaad hai na.

Yaad hai sahab, yaad hai..text: The worker says he remembers it.

Gawah, tum bhi sun rahe ho. Pichhli baar.text: The hirer asks what was agreed earlier about when the work finishes and how many days after that.
Gawah, tum bhi sun rahe ho. Pichhli baar.quote: Gawah, tum bhi sun rahe ho. Pichhli baar kya tay hua tha, khatam kab tak, aur uske baad kitna roz?

Darne ki baat nahi, likha hua achha hota.text: Devendra says there is no need to be afraid and that written terms are better, for your sake too.
Darne ki baat nahi, likha hua achha hota.quote: Darne ki baat nahi, likha hua achha hota hai. Tumhare liye bhi.

Sahi baat hai sahab. Achha, kal sariya a.text: Shakeel says the pillar reinforcement will arrive tomorrow and asks the hirer to look at a photo on WhatsApp.
Sahi baat hai sahab. Achha, kal sariya a.quote: Sahi baat hai sahab. Achha, kal sariya aa raha hai pillar ka, ek baar aap photo dekh lena WhatsApp pe.

Bhej dena. Aur ret thodi moti lag rahi t.text: The hirer says to send it, and says the sand looked a bit coarse in the previous photo.
Bhej dena. Aur ret thodi moti lag rahi t.quote: Bhej dena. Aur ret thodi moti lag rahi thi pichhli photo mein.

Woh neev ke liye thi sahab, plaster mein.text: The worker says the sand was for the foundation and finer sand will be used for plaster.
Woh neev ke liye thi sahab, plaster mein.quote: Woh neev ke liye thi sahab, plaster mein baarik wali lagayenge.

Dhyaan rakhna. Chalo, mujhe bank jaana h.text: The hirer says to be careful and says he has to go to the bank now.
Dhyaan rakhna. Chalo, mujhe bank jaana h.quote: Dhyaan rakhna. Chalo, mujhe bank jaana hai abhi.

Ji sahab. To agle hafte sava lakh, aur p.text: The worker says that next week the amount is 125,000 rupees.
Ji sahab. To agle hafte sava lakh, aur p.quote: Ji sahab. To agle hafte sava lakh, aur parso aap aa rahe ho.

Ji sahab. To agle hafte sava lakh, aur p.text: The worker says the hirer is coming the day after tomorrow.
Ji sahab. To agle hafte sava lakh, aur p.quote: Ji sahab. To agle hafte sava lakh, aur parso aap aa rahe ho.

Haan parso aata hoon..text: The hirer accepts the previously proposed meeting date by saying he will come the day after tomorrow.

Sahab truck aa gaya sariya ka, main baad.text: The worker says the steel truck has arrived and he will do it later.
Sahab truck aa gaya sariya ka, main baad.quote: Sahab truck aa gaya sariya ka, main baad mein karta hoon. Khuda hafiz.
